name: The Westbury Dublin
insider_take: This elegant Georgian hotel sits in the heart of Dublin's shopping district, where literary legends once wandered and Irish hospitality meets timeless sophistication.
whats_special: The Westbury occupies a prime spot on Grafton Street, Dublin's premier shopping thoroughfare, just steps from Trinity College and the famous Book of Kells. The hotel's afternoon tea service has become a Dublin institution, served in the elegant Gallery lounge overlooking the bustling street below. As part of The Leading Hotels of the World, it maintains impeccable standards while celebrating authentic Irish charm.
pro_tip: Book the Balcony Suite for exclusive views over Grafton Street - you'll have front-row seats to Dublin's vibrant street life while enjoying complete privacy and luxury.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within a 2-minute walk of St. Stephen's Green, Dublin's Georgian garden square, and the famous Molly Malone statue. The nearby Davy Byrnes pub, featured in James Joyce's "Ulysses," is perfect for a literary-themed pint, while the hotel's own Wilde restaurant pays homage to Dublin's most famous wit, Oscar Wilde.
pros: Prime location on Grafton Street in Dublin's shopping district
Elegant luxury accommodations with refined Irish hospitality
Award-winning dining at The Marble Bar and Wilde Restaurant
Walking distance to Trinity College, Temple Bar, and major attractions
cons: Busy street location may have urban noise
